verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas stores Editor projects in the cloud, so data retention is a fair question. The only related evidence is a plans-page line item for "Project Archive and Restore" and the option to download apps for self-hosting, which give some indirect control over where project data lives and how long it is kept. Missing for 10: documented project/account deletion, retention policies or periods, deletion of data handled by the AI/MCP workflows, and any independent corroboration.
